title: Implement Claude Code plugin bundle
summary: Implement the Claude Code plugin: manifest, .mcp.json, /planner skill, SessionStart hook, marketplace.json, README.
description:
Build the complete Claude Code plugin bundle and self-hosted marketplace entry.

## Current state
- plugins/claude-code/ created in P001 (scaffold).
- @agent-plan/mcp is published on npm and provides planner-* tools including planner-web (start/status/stop) and planner-load/stop (post-PR #16).

## Work items
- .claude-plugin/plugin.json — manifest (name agent-plan, version, description).
- .mcp.json — reference @agent-plan/mcp stdio server (npx -y @agent-plan/mcp). Auto-starts when plugin enabled.
- skills/planner/SKILL.md — /planner command routing to MCP tools (derived from _shared/planner-skill.md.in with HARNESS=Claude Code, LOAD_COMMAND=/planner load).
- hooks/hooks.json — SessionStart hook (command type) running scripts/notify-session-start.sh. Non-blocking: prints notify only, does NOT start planner/web.
- scripts/notify-session-start.sh — derived from _shared/notify-session-start.sh.in.
- marketplace.json — Claude Code marketplace listing the agent-plan plugin, source pointing to this repo path.
- plugins/claude-code/README.md — install instructions (marketplace + --plugin-dir dev), behavior notes.

## Behaviors to preserve
- Planner disabled by default; web does NOT auto-start.
- /planner load = enable + web(LAN) + recap; /planner stop = disable + stop web.
- Web UI address only on /planner load recap or /planner web status.
- SessionStart hook non-blocking notification only.

## Code references
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts — tool names/signatures the SKILL.md routes to.
- packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:plannerCommandTemplate — existing routing to port.
